result.summary: 250000 of 250000 targets have validated index lists. 0 certified gaps. 0 unresolved targets.
result.witness_encoding: Base64-decode, then zlib-decompress. Each nonzero byte is a literal summand index k. A zero ends the current list and advances N by one, starting at scope_inclusive[0]. There is exactly one terminated list per target. An empty list corresponds to a certified gap or an unresolved target as recorded below.
result.sanity_check: All nonempty subsets of [3,4,12,17] were checked independently against the exact search.
result.justification: Each published list was checked for its sum and every divisibility conflict. At a split, every legal completion either omits the pivot or includes it and omits all its neighbors. These children exhaust the possibilities. At an independent leaf, bit s is set exactly when a subset sums to s, by induction on the free weights with the empty subset as base case. Positive weights make truncation above the target bound exact. Exclusion is reported only after the full tree closes.
